new_findings.title: Pressing Enter to split a paragraph that carries a bookmark duplicates the bookmark name AND anchor id onto the newly created paragraph (multiplies with each split)
new_findings.repro: 1) Type a paragraph; References → Bookmark → name 'mark1' → Add. 2) Caret at end of that paragraph; press Enter; type new text. 3) Observe new paragraph carries the SAME data-bookmark='mark1' AND same np3-ref-* id. Repeat Enter-splits → 3+ paragraphs all 'mark1' with identical ids; bookmarks dialog lists duplicate entries; state persists across reload.
new_findings.expected: new paragraph from split gets fresh/empty identity; bookmark stays anchored to its original paragraph only
new_findings.controls: paragraphs created by other means (dialog insert, bibliography entry) do not receive ids/bookmarks; duplication strictly follows the Enter-split of a paragraph carrying the attributes (reproduced on 2 consecutive splits)
new_findings.source_mechanism: paragraph split clones the source paragraph element attributes (id, data-bookmark) without regeneration — same mechanism family as L1-G's duplicate heading anchor ids after Enter-split (execCommand/formatBlock & split path; bookmark attrs not stripped)
new_findings.impact: duplicate DOM ids; bookmark list pollution (N identical entries); Go-to-bookmark navigation may land on an arbitrary clone. Fix: on paragraph split, strip/regenerate id and data-bookmark on the new block

new_findings.title: Undoing simple adjacent text deletions around a citation removes the References bibliography while leaving the in-text citation link intact (dangling citation)
new_findings.repro: 1) Caret mid-paragraph; References → Citation (Roe/Paper/2021) → Insert (in-text '(Roe, 2021)' link + References heading + 'Roe. Paper. 2021' entry visible). 2) Caret right after the link; Backspace ×2 (deletes '1)'). 3) Ctrl+Z ×2. Observed: link text fully restored '(Roe, 2021)', but References heading + bibliography entry are GONE.
new_findings.expected: Undo restores exactly the two deleted characters; bibliography unchanged
new_findings.controls: pre-backspace state had bibliography present (paragraph list + data-bibliography heading); post-undo link present + bibliography absent — inconsistent pair not reachable by any single legitimate undo step
new_findings.source_mechanism: citation-synchronization (bibliography rebuild on citation-link edits) runs as a non-undoable side mutation during the backspaces; character-level Undo restores text but not the bibliography block
new_findings.impact: citation points to a bibliography that no longer exists; document exports/reads as broken citation. Fix: make bibliography maintenance undo-consistent or defer it to commit
